name: ai-agent-builder-platform
description: Base monorepo for the AI Agent Builder and Workflow Engine platform.

scripts.docker:config: docker compose -f deployment/compose.yaml config --quiet && docker compose -f deployment/compose.yaml -f deployment/compose.dev.yaml config --quiet
scripts.docker:infra: docker compose -f deployment/compose.yaml up -d --wait postgres redis-cache redis-queue seaweedfs bucket-bootstrap
scripts.docker:quality: docker compose -f deployment/compose.yaml --profile quality run --rm --build --no-deps quality
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @agent-builder/contracts && npm run build --workspace @agent-builder/backend && npm run build --workspace @agent-builder/frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:boundaries && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.quality: npm run ai:check && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
